title: Finite adic chain with generic-annihilated quotients
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], $T$ a closed subset with generic point $\xi$, and $F$ a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with support $T$, where support uses the module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and modules $P(k)$ for $k\in\mathbb N$ with $P(0)=F$, $P(n)$ zero, and $P(k)$ coherent for $k\leq n$. For every $k<n$ there is a short exact sequence $0\to P(k+1)\to P(k)\to G_k\to0$ with $G_k$ coherent, supported in $T$, and its stalk at $\xi$ annihilated by the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$.

source.place: Tag 01YF, irreducible-support ideal-power and final generic-point paragraphs; Tag 01YE for the generic ideal inclusion. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YF and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YE.

proof.text: Construct the vanishing ideal J of T and apply coherent_support_vanishingIdeal_nilpotence to obtain n with the actual image product J^n F zero. The helper uses an acyclic affine-cover proof of Stacks 01Y9. Only the exponent is chosen; the ideal and every sheaf are explicit constructions.

Define P(t) as the image product J^t F. Apply quasi-coherent pushforward and kernel closure to J. The private power_quasiCoherent helper is proved for any quasi-coherent module mapping to the unit, not just IdealSheafData; tensor and image closure prove its induction. Coherent submodule and cokernel closure give coherence. The zero-power inclusion is an isomorphism.

The local idealSheafPower_factor and product_power_factor are generalized to arbitrary module morphisms to the tensor unit, with no ideal-sheaf or monicity assumption. Recursion factors power inclusions; image.map on the tensor naturality square gives product factorization. Specialize to J.toModulesι to construct f:P(t+1) -> P(t). Image monicity gives Mono f, so its cokernel sequence is short exact. Apply module_stalk_exact and ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective through stalk_map_mono to show support containment.

Use generic_ideal_range generalized to an arbitrary subset T and an ideal J characterized by pointwise vanishing on T, assuming ξ belongs to T and specializes to each point of T; no closedness or generic-point equality is assumed by this helper. Sections of J have nonunit germ at ξ. Conversely a nonunit germ is represented by f whose basic open omits ξ, hence every specialization in T, so f belongs to J. Specialize using reduced_induced_closed_subscheme and hξ.

The ideal-product stalk theorem identifies the range of b(t) with I^t times F_xi for positive t. At zero b(0) is the image inclusion of the left unitor, hence an isomorphism and has full range. Lift a quotient germ to y in P(t)_xi. If a is in I, the image of a*y in F_xi belongs to I^(t+1) F_xi, so it lifts along b(t+1) to z. Injectivity of b(t)_xi implies f_xi(z)=a*y. The cokernel projection kills f_xi(z), proving maximal-ideal annihilation of the quotient.

Set Q(0)=F and Q(k+1)=P(k), with terminal index n+1. The first map is the zero-power isomorphism b(0), with zero cokernel; all later steps are the constructed cokernel sequences. This extra zero quotient avoids transporting the chain along the zero-power isomorphism. No conditions are required past the terminal index.

proof_origin.based_on: Stacks 01YF adic reduction, proved vanishing-ideal nilpotence, generalized unit-valued module power factorization, and a leading zero quotient; repair removes word-for-word duplicate helpers without cyclic imports.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_support_adic_chain
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X) (ξ : X)
    (hξ : IsGenericPoint ξ (T : Set X))
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hSupp : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} = (T : Set X)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (P : ℕ → X.Modules), P 0 = F ∧ IsZero (P n) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≤ n → RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (P k)) ∧
      ∀ k, k < n → ∃ (G : X.Modules) (f : P (k + 1) ⟶ P k) (g : P k ⟶ G)
        (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact ∧
        RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G ∧
        {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (G.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ (T : Set X) ∧
        (∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk ξ),
          ∀ m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G, a • m = 0)
